title: Misspecification-Robust Shrinkage and Selection for VAR Forecasts and IRFs
abstract: arXiv:2502.03693v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vector autoregressions (VARs) are vulnerable to dynamic misspecification, forcing researchers to navigate complex bias-variance trade-offs when forecasting or estimating impulse response functions (IRFs). We derive novel, task-specific selection criteria -- PC for forecasting and IRFC for IRF estimation -- based on asymptotically unbiased estimates of frequentist risk under local dynamic misspecification. These criteria give empirical researchers a fully data-driven and misspecification-aware workflow that simultaneously selects among candidate estimators, the degree of Bayesian shrinkage, and the lag length. IRFC is the first criterion allowing researchers to seamlessly choose between iterated-VAR and local-projection IRF estimators while jointly tuning shrinkage and lag length for the task at hand.

translated_title: 针对VAR预测与脉冲响应函数的误设稳健收缩与选择
translated_abstract: 向量自回归（VAR）模型容易受到动态误设的影响，这迫使研究人员在预测或估计脉冲响应函数（IRFs）时，需要权衡复杂的偏差-方差问题。我们基于局部动态误设下的频率风险渐近无偏估计，推导出了新的、任务特定的选择准则——用于预测的PC准则和用于IRF估计的IRFC准则。这些准则为实证研究人员提供了一种完全数据驱动且对误设敏感的工作流程，能够同时选择候选估计器、贝叶斯收缩程度和滞后长度。IRFC是第一个允许研究人员在迭代VAR和局部投影IRF估计器之间无缝选择，并同时针对当前任务调整收缩和滞后长度的准则。
tldr: 本文提出了针对VAR模型动态误设的两种新选择准则（PC和IRFC），实现了数据驱动的估计器、收缩程度和滞后长度的联合选择，其中IRFC首次支持在迭代VAR与局部投影IRF估计器间灵活切换。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two novel misspecification-robust selection criteria (PC and IRFC) for VAR forecasting and IRF estimation, enabling joint data-driven selection of estimators, shrinkage, and lag length, with IRFC being the first to seamlessly choose between iterated-VAR and local-projection IRF estimators.
